page_title: TOR 2-2 JUV | Torino v Juventus 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alberto Paleari intercepts the ball.
90+3' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+3' Emil Holm (Juventus) fires a bullet of a shot from distance, but the goalkeeper blocks his attempt.
90+3' A snap shot by Che Adams (Torino) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Mattia Perin produces a good save to thwart him.
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The referee awards a corner and Niels Nkounkou (Torino) goes over to take it.
88' Enzo Ebosse (Torino) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
88' The referee is firm and issues Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) a deserved yellow card.
84' 2 - 2 Goal! Che Adams (Torino) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 2:2.
84' The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
83' Enzo Ebosse (Torino) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
83' Alieu Njie (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
79' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.

78' What a wasted opportunity by Alieu Njie (Torino)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top of the net, but Mattia Perin makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
78' Substitution. Jeremie Boga makes his way off the pitch and Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) comes on as his replacement.
77' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:14.
73' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Juventus out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
71' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fabio Miretti (Juventus) will replace Francisco Conceicao.
70' A substitution has been made. Khephren Thuram goes off and Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) comes on.
70' A cross from Emil Holm (Juventus) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
69' Here is a change. Marcus Pedersen is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Matteo Prati (Torino).
64' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Luca Zufferli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' The substitution is prepared. Niels Nkounkou (Torino) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rafael Obrador.
63' Substitution. Alieu Njie (Torino) in, Emirhan Ilkhan out.
63' Luciano Spalletti has decided to substitute Andrea Cambiaso and he is replaced by Emil Holm (Juventus).
62' Here comes a substitution. Jonathan David (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Dusan Vlahovic.

60' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Cesare Casadei (Torino) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the right post. 1:2.
59' The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
57' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Duvan Zapata leaves the pitch and Che Adams (Torino) comes on.

54' 0 - 2 Goal! Francisco Conceicao produces a great pass that finds Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
53' Wasted opportunity. Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
52' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Mattia Perin comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
49' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) prepares to take a corner kick.
49' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Alberto Paleari sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
49' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
48' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
46' A cross by Marcus Pedersen (Torino) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
46' It is time for a substitution. Cesare Casadei (Torino) is on for Gvidas Gineitis.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' The total number of attempts is 5:10.

40' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Juventus are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
36' Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
34' Wonderful movement by Juventus. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

31' Juventus slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
29' Rafael Obrador (Torino) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
26' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
25' 0 - 1 Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) puts the ball in the back of the net!
23' Juventus force their opponents to concede a corner.
21' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jeremie Boga (Juventus). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
19' Juventus are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

16' Great chance! Federico Gatti (Juventus) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
16' Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
15' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
14' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 46:54.
12' Saul Coco (Torino) commits a foul during an attacking move. It's a free kick to Juventus, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
11' Torino get a corner.
11' Duvan Zapata (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
8' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Rafael Obrador (Torino) steps up to send the ball in.
2' Torino control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The match will be delayed.
